from qiskit.optimization.algorithms import MinimumEigenOptimizer

from qiskit.optimization import QuadraticObjective
from dwave.system import DWaveSampler

import networkx as nx

def solve_telescope_scheduling():
    # Define the QUBO
    qubo = QuadraticProgram()

    # Add variables
    qubo.binary_var("x1")
    qubo.binary_var("x2")
    qubo.binary_var("x3")
    qubo.binary_var("x4")
    qubo.binary_var("x5")

    qubo.minimize(
        linear_terms={

            "x2": -5,
            "x3": -3,
            "x4": -6,
            "x5": -2,
        },
        quadratic_terms={

            ("x2", "x2"): 0,
            ("x3", "x3"): 0,
            ("x4", "x4"): 0,
            ("x5", "x5"): 0,
        },
    )

    qubo.linear_constraint(linear={ "x1": 1, "x2": 1, "x3": 1, "x4": 1, "x5": 1 }, sense="=", rhs=3)

    qubo.linear_constraint(linear={ "x2": 1, "x4": 1 }, sense="=", rhs=0)

    qubo_converter = QuadraticProgramConverter(quadratic_objective=LinearObjectiveToQuadraticObjective())
    qubo_converter.convert(qubo)

    # Add penalty terms
    penalty_converter = LinearConstraintToPenalty(penalty=LinearConstraintToPenalty.PENALTY_SLACK)
    penalty_converter.convert(qubo)
    penalty_converter = LinearEqualityToPenaltyConverter(penalty=LinearConstraintToPenalty.PENALTY_SLACK)

        "x3": result["variable_values"]["x3"],

        "feasible_objective_quality": feasible_objective_quality,
